title: Prove memLp_sLocalCarvingGenerator (Ch11 Sec1b, Theorem 11.1.2.1(3), p. 480)
body:
Proves `memLp_sLocalCarvingGenerator` (Theorem 11.1.2.1(3), p. 480) in `RiemannMasullo/Ch11_ShellStructure/Sec1b.lean`. Only the proof and private helpers are added (plus `import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.ExpDecay`); no statement changes.

Closes #5193

**Proof.** Both cutoff bands lie in `[Λ⁻¹, ∞)`. On such norms the raw theta generator is bounded by `D · |g|^(-k)` with `k = ⌈s⌉₊ + 1`:
- above a threshold `T`, by `sLocalAdelicTheta_decay_large` (the series at a class equals S-local theta at the projection of a representative that is a unit outside S; its S-norm equals the class norm by `sIdeleNorm_spec`);
- on `Λ⁻¹ ≤ |g| ≤ T`, by continuity on a compact set (properness of the idele class norm).

The norm-one character average inherits the bound times the norm-one mass and is continuous (same argument as `homogeneousAdelicTheta_continuous`). The weighted L² integral is then transported to ℝ: `ideleClassTamagawaMeasure_eq_smul_canonical`, and log-norm carries the canonical Haar measure to Lebesgue measure (copy of the private argument in Ch11 Sec2a). On ℝ, `(1+x²)^(s/2) ≤ exp(s|x|)` and `integrable_of_isBigO_exp_neg` finish. The hypotheses `f(0) = 0` and `𝓕f(0) = 0` are not needed, because the band stays away from norm 0.

New private helpers (all directly above the theorem): `memLp_sLocalCarvingGenerator_norm`, `_decay`, `_isCompact`, `_bound`, `_continuous`, `_pointwise`, `_integrable_real`, `_measurePreserving`.

- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch11_ShellStructure.Sec1b`: OK, about 16 s for the module.
- Full `lake build`: OK (19188 jobs).
- `scripts/lint.sh`: ok.
- `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` between the module's signatures before and after (each from `lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean RiemannMasullo.Ch11_ShellStructure.Sec1b`): empty.
- `#print axioms RiemannMasullo.memLp_sLocalCarvingGenerator`: `[propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. The `sorryAx` comes only from `sAdeleSchwartzFourier`, which appears in the statement's hypothesis and is upstream (its own `#print axioms` shows `sorryAx`). Every other library lemma used shows only `propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound`.

`sLocalUncutCarving_lt` (#5186) and `sLocalCarvingLimit_eq_closedSpan` (#5194) in the same file were not taken.
